views.name: LinkedIn messages

draft: Happy to chat next week. Would Tuesday afternoon work for you?

messages.body:
Hi Niv, I came across your work on making automation more accessible to product teams. The way you approach inspectable workflows really resonated with me.

We’re exploring a similar challenge at Northstar. Would you be open to comparing notes?

Hi Maya, thanks for reaching out! Happy to compare notes. We’ve been focusing on helping teams understand and edit the data behind their workflows.

What’s the biggest bottleneck for your team today?

Mostly the handoff between our CRM and internal tools. There’s a lot of useful context in the data, but it’s hard for anyone outside engineering to work with it.

A short conversation next week would be great.
